learning_anchors.label: Introductory / Declarative
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Syntax-level understanding self-teachable in under 15 hours without formal prerequisites.
typical_signals: Follows basic documentation tutorials without debugging
Understands core data types and keywords

learning_anchors.label: Foundational Practical
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Standard tooling patterns and descriptive methods mastered in 15 to 40 hours with basic programming prerequisites.
typical_signals: Writes structured SQL queries and descriptive summaries
Identifies basic anomalies and data hygiene issues

learning_anchors.label: Intermediate Systemic
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Requires multi-step analytical reasoning, algorithmic tradeoffs, and edge-case management (30 to 65 hours).
typical_signals: Implements window partitions and statistical hypothesis tests
Trains supervised models with disciplined cross-validation

learning_anchors.label: Advanced Methodological / Architectural
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Theoretical, econometric, or distributed architectural concepts demanding deep technical foundations (50 to 100 hours).
typical_signals: Applies causal inference identification frameworks
Configures distributed cluster execution and partitions

learning_anchors.label: Expert Frontier
learning_anchors.anchor_description: Novel algorithmic research, complex identification strategies, and multi-petabyte distributed consensus (>100 hours).
typical_signals: Designs custom estimation estimators under confounding
Architects enterprise-wide data platform operating systems

application_anchors.label: Isolated Templated
application_anchors.anchor_description: Execution within clean sandbox environments against scripted expectations.
typical_signals: Executes queries against pre-filtered tables
Passes deterministic unit checks in controlled notebooks

application_anchors.label: Guided Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Applied to production schemas with established conventions and peer review.
typical_signals: Discovers standard outliers and missing values in upstream feeds
Builds standardized reporting queries on normalized schemas

application_anchors.label: Unconstrained Real-World
application_anchors.anchor_description: Navigates messy production anomalies, schema drift, and multi-departmental metric definitions.
typical_signals: Debugs silent pipeline corruption and missingness mechanisms
Reconciles conflicting KPI definitions across operational tables

application_anchors.label: High-Stakes Production
application_anchors.anchor_description: Mission-critical applications where mistakes compromise live user traffic, inference latency, or model validity.
typical_signals: Prevents subtle temporal lookahead leakage in asynchronous stores
Monitors online experimentation without sample ratio mismatches

application_anchors.label: Strategic Enterprise Architecture
application_anchors.anchor_description: Organizational-level impact involving causal policy counterfactuals or distributed cluster survivability.
typical_signals: Evaluates irreversible business policy interventions under unobserved confounders
Diagnoses complex distributed memory spills and partition skew at scale
